class.name: HEGoCookExtension
class.brief_description: A child of an [HEGoNode3D] that takes part in its cooks.
class.description: A cook normally ends by rebuilding the [code]Outputs[/code] subtree. An extension makes it do more, or do it differently: the HEGo Strata bridge, for example, publishes the cook's heightfields into terrain layers. Add one as a direct child of the HEGo node. HEGo calls the hooks below on every such child, in child order, and never needs to know which addon it came from. Every hook has a default that does nothing, so an extension overrides only what it needs. Hooks that return a Dictionary report [code]{ok, message}[/code]. Returning [code]ok: false[/code] stops the cook and leaves the previous output in place. The extension that stops a cook records its own reason; the others are told through [method cook_failed]. [param cook] is one dictionary shared by every extension and input handler for the duration of one cook. HEGo reads [code]strict[/code] from it and collects input failures in [code]errors[/code]. Keep anything of your own under your own key.

method.name: cook_prepare
method.description: The cook is about to start, before anything is sent to Houdini. Set [code]cook.strict = true[/code] to make any input that cannot be sent fail the whole cook, rather than being skipped with a warning.

method.name: cook_before
method.description: Inputs and parameters are in place and the HDA is about to cook.

method.name: cook_commit
method.description: The HDA cooked and nothing has been replaced yet. [code]context.cook_state[/code] is the shared cook dictionary. Return [code]ok: false[/code] to keep the previous output.

method.name: cook_failed
method.description: The cook stopped before finishing, at any step, with [param message] saying why.

method.name: skips_output_handler
method.description: Whether this cook should skip the output handler [param handler], one entry of [method HEGoNode3D.output_handlers], for example because the extension produces that kind of output itself. [param handler] is either one of HEGo's own handler scripts or an [HEGoOutputHandler] instance; an extension that consumes the heightfields skips the latter when [method HEGoOutputHandler.handles_heightfields] is true, without naming it.

method.name: inputs_changed
method.description: The host's inputs or parameters changed since the last cook.

method.name: requires_explicit_cook
method.description: Whether the host should only cook when asked, rather than recooking automatically on every change the panel makes.
